verdict.rationale: The only liability and chargeback statement in the pack (Crossmint absorbing dispute risk) is documented for the general Checkout product. The pack itself notes it is not specific to agent checkouts, so it cannot be credited to agent-initiated transactions. The agent-card spending allowances, merchant locking and network-enforced rails are adjacent fraud controls; none documents who bears fraud, liability or chargeback risk when an agent initiates a purchase.

support.subject: As a merchant, the fraud, liability, and chargeback rules for agent-initiated transactions are documented so I know who bears the risk
